description: Own exchange candles (Android data/remote/candles/ExchangeCandleSources.kt, iOS Shared/Services/Candles/ExchangeCandleSources.swift). 'fetch': pair (marketKey, marketName, base, quote, pairId, contract = FuturesContractType name, tradFi) + interval (H1/H4/D1) + limit; 'responses' maps request URL -> response body (missing URL = request failed); 'urls' = requests in order; 'expected' = candles [openTime ms, open, high, low, close, base volume, quote volume or null], ascending, or null (no candles). Bodies follow the public docs (Kraken: verbatim docs example). 'supports': which source key (marketKey of the matching source) serves the pair (null = none) and whether the Binance fallback chain may be used (false for TradFi, DEX and dated futures).

fetch.name: Kraken: docs example, newest 3, quote volume = vwap × volume
Kraken: error array = no candles
Bitstamp: 4 h step, objects with strings
Bitvavo: daily, newest first, reversed
Bybit Futures: linear 1 h, turnover = quote volume
Bybit spot: retCode not 0 = no candles
OKX Futures: swap 4 h, volume = volCcy (base), quote = volCcyQuote
OKX spot: 1 year daily over two pages (after = oldest ts)
Coinbase: 4 h aggregated from hourly candles
Binance: mirror down, then api.binance.com (pair symbol ETHBTC)
Binance Futures COIN-M: dapi, volume = base volume, no quote volume
Binance Futures USDⓈ-M (TradFi perpetual XAUUSDT): fapi daily
Binance.US: own endpoint
Bitfinex: 1 h, OPEN-CLOSE-HIGH-LOW order, newest first
Bitfinex: 4 h aggregated from 1 h, pair id with colon
Bitget Futures (TradFi NVDA): v3 candles over two pages with endTime
Bitget spot: error code = no candles
Gate.io: daily, seconds, quote volume second, open sixth
KuCoin: 4 h window in seconds, open-close-high-low order
MEXC spot: 60m, docs example layout
MEXC Futures (TradFi gold): parallel arrays, volume from amount / close
HTX: 60min, amount base, vol quote, newest first
Gemini: 1day fails, then 1d; newest first
Crypto.com: o/h/l/c/v/t objects, window in ms
Upbit: daily over two pages (to = oldest candle_date_time_utc)
WOO X Futures: v3 rows with startTimestamp
Poloniex: low-high-open-close, startTime at index 12
Deribit: parallel arrays, volume base, cost quote
Deribit: status no_data = no candles
Hyperliquid: POST candleSnapshot
One Trading: ISO times, newest first, volume = quote
Kraken: chain pair of the daily-close fallback (altname XBTUSD, answer keyed XXBTZUSD), daily
Bybit spot: chain pair of the daily-close fallback (PEPEUSDT), daily, limit 1000

supports.name: Binance Futures quarterly: own candles of that contract (symbol with delivery date), never the perpetual's
Dated contract on an exchange without own dated candles: no chart, no fallback
TradFi on MEXC Futures: own futures candles, never a crypto token's
TradFi on an exchange without own candles: no chart
WOO X spot id without SPOT_
Coinbase USDT-USD (USDT/USD daily closes, gap filler)
